items.title: CF Industries Holdings (CF) Yazoo City Outage Now Stretches Into First Half Of 2027
items.summary: CF Industries Holdings (NYSE:CF) reported a prolonged outage at its Yazoo City, Mississippi facility, with operations not expected to resume until the first half of 2027. The incident at the Yazoo City Complex is materially affecting production volumes and margins for the company’s UAN and AN product lines. Management is finalizing restoration cost estimates and expects a significant portion of these expenses to be covered by insurance. The Yazoo City outage, and its hit to UAN and AN...
